✨ phoneinfoga | Go
🎯 Primary Use Case: Information gathering and OSINT investigation on phone numbers.
✨ Key Features: • Check if phone number exists • Gather basic information (country, line type, carrier) • OSINT footprinting using external APIs, phone books & search engines • Check for reputation reports, social media, disposable numbers • Graphical user interface
📖 Summary: PhoneInfoga is an advanced Go-based framework for gathering information about phone numbers. It collects basic details like country, carrier, and line type, and then uses various OSINT techniques, external APIs, and search engines to find potential VoIP providers or identify owners. It also offers a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use.
